messages:
jamie: Post-deploy done for v2.14.3. Quick flag: EU synthetic sampler p95 jumped ~220ms after the shift. Can we triage before we decide pin/rollback?

deploy-bot: rollout complete across regions. Post-deploy synth wave started at 3324507790. Samples: 04/18 10:23Z. Alerts auto-generated.

sasha: saw the same. EU1 heartbeats look intact but tail latency skews vs USW. Not seeing 5xxs, mostly p95/p99 tail.

mike: digging into metrics — KV probe last-hop latency in eu1 is +140-260ms vs usual. Sequence shows a small periodic bump every ~30s. Could be clock skew between probe runners.

olivia: can we replay the synth from a controlled runner to rule out routing jitter? I'll run a cross-zone replay from `usw-prober-02` to `eu-prober-01` now.

oncall-bot: replay job started by olivia at 3324507850 (job id: replay-3312). ETA ~30s.

sasha: also seeing small timestamp drift in probe logs — lines where `started_at` is ahead of `finished_at` by ~100-200ms in eu prober logs. That smells like NTP hiccup on eu runners.

mike: confirmed. SSH into `eu-prober-01` shows chrony offset ~0.17s. Not huge but enough to affect timing-based synthetic checks.

olivia: results from replay: p95 back to normal when run from EU-origin prober, but cross-zone replay still shows ~180ms tail. Suggests inter-region path/jitter + clock offsets affecting our measurement.

jamie: thanks. Proposal: 1) hold pin/rollback decision, 2) hotpatch smoke-check config to use wall-clock tolerant timing for this wave (increase probe TTL/grace by 250ms), 3) start NTP resync on EU probers and re-run replay. Anyone object?

sasha: agree. For hotpatch we should scope to synth-check only, not global probe config. Keep sample window small so we don't mask real regressions.

mike: +1. I'll open a quick runbook step: `eng-releases/playbooks/smoke-hotpatch` — we can add a `grace_ms` override. Use `grace_ms=300` for the next 10min.

olivia: resync kicked (chrony restart) on eu probers. Monitoring drift. Will rerun replays in ~2m.

oncall-bot: replay job replay-3312 complete at 3324507905. Summary: cross-zone p95 improved by ~80ms after network path artifacts settled.

jamie: follow-up: applying hotpatch now for next 10m, then we'll revert and re-evaluate. No rollback for now. Noting in release notes and tagging the rollout: `note: transient cross-zone probe jitter, hotpatch applied to synth checks, probers NTP-resynced`.

mike: logged the change and created a short alert suppression for the 10m window so oncall doesn't page. Link: https://go/internal/ops/issue/5543

sasha: will re-run a full sample sweep after revert and post numbers.

jamie: thanks team. If anything degrades (errors/5xxs) we escalate to rollback. Otherwise we'll document in the post-release notes and close the thread in 1h. :thumbsup:
